get_base_runner_default_cfg: build a D2Go BaseRunner config with default solver, metric gathering, and writer period settings
get_detectron2go_runner_default_cfg: build a Detectron2GoRunner config with FBNet, quantization, FSDP, and distillation defaults
get_generalized_rcnn_runner_default_cfg: build a GeneralizedRCNNRunner config with RCNN export, postprocess, and quantization prepare options
add_distillation_configs: add distillation config with teacher model type, algorithm, and helper settings to a CfgNode
preprocess_cfg: preprocess a D2Go CfgNode config object and return it for downstream use
